image_location_description: Left side: the largest light/dark gray rectangular block with studs on top.

steps.title: Lower block
steps.description: Stack 2x 2x4 bricks (3001) Dark Bluish Gray to fill 4x4.

steps.title: Beltline layer
steps.description: Add 1x 4x4 plate (3031) Light Bluish Gray on top.

steps.title: Upper block
steps.description: Build next layer with 4x 1x4 bricks (3010) Light Bluish Gray.

steps.title: Studded roof
steps.description: Cover top with 4x 1x4 plates (3710) Light Bluish Gray.

steps.title: Top greebles/mounts
steps.description: Add 1x 2x2 plate (3022), 2x 1x2 plates (3023), 2x 1x1 plates (3024), all DBG.
